description: Shuffles a 78-card Rider–Waite–Smith deck with a cryptographic random generator and deals a spread. Returns each position with the card, its orientation, the meaning for that orientation and a link that shows the spread with card pictures.

count.description: Number of cards for spread=custom when positions are not given.

lang.description: Language of names and meanings. Default lt.

majors_only.description: Use only the 22 Major Arcana. Default false.

positions.description: For spread=custom: one position or question per card.

question.description: The user's question, stored in the share link.

spread.description: Spread id. Default ppf (past, present, future). custom takes positions or count.

name: draw_cards
title: Draw tarot cards
